annotations.title: List the verified starter boards (free, offline)

description:
Indexed Jobs search is LIVE (paid, on your own Apify token): one call searches 8,800+ Greenhouse, Ashby and Lever company boards, with radius and salary filters, from a fresh daily index (not a live scrape of a few boards). Run it as the Apify Actor https://apify.com/fairquery/jobs-index-search or the MCP https://mcp.getfairquery.com/jobs-index/mcp (send your Apify token). New Apify accounts get a $5 starter credit. This free tool stays free and live-scans the 135-board starter list.
WHAT: List the bundled starter list of company job boards that Fairquery verified on their official ATS APIs (company, domain, ats, slug, verified_at, jobs_at_verification).
WHEN: To pick companies to scan, or to know which names jobs_find_board resolves instantly.
WHEN NOT: Live jobs on one board (jobs_get_board), a place search across this list (jobs_search_by_location), or companies not in the list (jobs_find_board). The list is a starting point (135 boards), not the paid indexed search (8,800+ boards, Apify Actor fairquery/jobs-index-search).
BEHAVIOR: Runs on this Fairquery-hosted Worker (Cloudflare), not on the caller's machine; inputs leave the client. This Worker's code is designed not to store inputs or results. No further network call: it reads a static list compiled into this Worker. jobs_at_verification is a snapshot from verified_at and goes stale.
COST: No APIFY_TOKEN, no billing.
RETURNS: Paged "seed_board" rows in the fixed bundled order (original boards stay first, so earlier offsets stay put). 135 Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby boards.
PARAMETERS: ats narrows the list; omit it for the whole starter list (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby). Personio, Pinpoint and Gem are not in the starter list (named accounts only). meta.by_ats always counts the whole list per ATS and ignores ats, so take paging totals from total. Feed ats + slug of any item straight into jobs_get_board.
EXAMPLE: {"ats":"lever"} -> Palantir, Spotify, Zoox, Ro, then more Lever boards.

ats.description: Optional filter: "greenhouse" | "lever" | "ashby" | "personio" | "pinpoint" | "gem"; default all. The starter list has no Personio, Pinpoint or Gem boards

offset.description: Optional items to skip, integer >= 0, default 0; pass nextOffset from the previous response

name: jobs_list_seed_boards

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

items.description: Result rows. Each has "type": "job" (job_key, title, company, locations, countries, remote, posted_at, verified_open_at, age_days, long_open, apply_url, source_url, ...), "board", "company", "seed_board", "open_check" or "error" (code, message, retryable)

meta.description: Tool-specific context: board totals, request counts, cost notes

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null when done

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

total.description: Total items after filters, before paging
